macro_convention: Mean over gold-supported slots, fixed across systems; zero_division=0
metric_definition: Exact micro sets per turn: act=(slot,value,sorted attributes); slot_value=(slot,value); attribute=(slot,value,attribute). Casefold/whitespace only. Invalid JSON contributes gold FN. Not the original paper metric.
label_budget: B0 vocabulary from all training rows; LoRA pilot subset256/40steps. This comparison does not equalize annotation budget.
